Build the record the monthly report leaves behind

report_record.Rd

The columns are those of its own table, UbepRapporto_CL, and only those: the job has a table of its own rather than a discriminating column in the round's or the observer's, whose rules read the last record without asking who wrote it. Every column is present on every run, zeroed when there is nothing to count, because the rule on the incomplete record counts them.

Usage

report_record(esito, posta)

Arguments

esito

What provisioning_report() returned.

posta

Whether the run was allowed to send. No fallback, as in the round's record: a caller that forgot it would report the post as off.

Value

A named list, ready for run_record_json().

Details

referenti counts the reports of the month, the one to IT included: those due, as today's reading or the last whole one found them, and those the ledger says left on earlier days. mese_completo is the design's gia_mandati + mandati == referenti, on those. A day that cannot read judges the month on the last whole reading, so a reading that fails after the month was sent does not make it late; with no whole reading on record nothing is due, and the month is not called late on a guess. in_ritardo is report_late().

Phase 1 asks no instance and does not measure the year without access, so istanze_non_lette and voci_senza_accessi are zero.

Names and codes only, and never a person: the record is shipped to a workspace and kept.
